Zone 12 gives 'CP (north of 16,5S)' and zone 14 'CP (south of 16,5S)', while this zone gives 'CP (east of 60W)'; the three CP boundaries overlap as published. Kept as published. PY0 parentheses (Fernando de Noronha, St Peter & Paul) name entities.
CE0 parentheses (Juan Fernandez, San Felix) name entities. '16,5S' decimal comma kept as published.
'PY0 (Trinidade)' (spelling as published) mapped to 273 Trindade & Martim Vaz Is.

'50E' is printed with the E as a superscript in both places (the text layer reads '50 E' for the first); transcribed '50E'. UA9 between 60 and 80N west of 50E is the western Komi Republic, European Russia (54) - mapped by geography, judgement call.

'R1F (FJL south of 80N)': FJL names the entity (61 Franz Josef Land); boundary 'south of 80N'. UA9 between 50 and 75E (60-80N) spans European Russia (Komi, 54) and Asiatic Russia (Yamal, Khanty-Mansi, 15): dxcc left null.
'betwwen' is a typo for 'between', kept as published in the boundary.
'60and' (missing space) kept as published in the boundary.
'Uaà' kept as published; an evident encoding slip for UA0 (UA-zero), cf. zones 22-25.
G (England) and GW (Wales) do not appear in this zone or anywhere in this edition's list.

'SV (Mt. Athos)' mapped to 180, '1A0 (SMOM)' to 246, '4U (Geneva)' to 117 ITU HQ (Geneva) - parentheses name entities. 'YU' mapped to 296 (ADIF 'SERBIA', the code that Yugoslavia/Serbia & Montenegro carried).

Country names in parentheses identify the entity. 'R1M (MV Island)' mapped to 151 Malyj Vysotskij I. (deleted in ADIF; ARRL: deleted). 'UN (Kazakhstan west of 50E)': Kazakhstan names the entity, boundary 'west of 50E'. UA2 mapped to 126 Kaliningrad.

'EX (Kyrgyztan west of 75E)' (spelling as published) boundary 'west of 75E'; 'EY (Tajikstan)' spelling as published; 'EZ (Turkmenistan, UA4 (east of 50E)' is published with the closing parenthesis after Turkmenistan missing - read as EZ (Turkmenistan), UA4 (east of 50E). UA9 south of 60N and west of 75E spans European Russia (Perm, southern Komi; 54) and Asiatic Russia (Sverdlovsk, Chelyabinsk, Kurgan, Tyumen, Omsk...; 15): dxcc left null.
'EX (Kyrgyzstaneast of 75E)' is published without a space after Kyrgyzstan; boundary 'east of 75E'.
JT appears in both zone 32 and zone 33 with no boundary given in either. UA8T is an old-series Russian prefix; mapped to Asiatic Russia (15) as it lies east of the Urals at 90-110E.
JT also in zone 32 without boundary. UA8V (old-series prefix) mapped to Asiatic Russia (15).
